name: gourmet-master
description: 全能顶级美食研发与私厨顾问全书 v3.0（动态联网采集 + 智能组装 + 多目标优化 + 自进化引擎）。内置可执行CLI引擎、结构化美食数据库与交互式HTML/PDF交付物生成器，全面覆盖科学减脂餐、中华八大菜系、正统西餐与全国硬核区域邪教美食。
description_zh: 全能顶级美食研发与私厨顾问全书 v3.0（动态联网采集 + 智能组装 + 多目标优化 + 自进化引擎）。内置可执行CLI引擎(scripts/gourmet_engine.py)、结构化美食数据库(data/culinary_db.json)与交互式HTML/PDF交付物生成器。
description_en: Commercial-grade Culinary R&D, Nutrition Calculation, and Private Chef Expert Plugin (v3.0). Features a dynamic closed-loop CLI engine covering Fitness Meals, Eight Great Chinese Cuisines, Classic Western Culinary Arts, and Chinese Regional Cult Delicacies.

displayName.zh: 全能顶级私厨与营养顾问

profession.zh: 美食研发与减脂营养专家

displayDescription.en: Dynamic live-fetching culinary R&D and clinical nutrition consultant. Converts vague household recipes into exact commercial grams/ml, calculates TDEE & BOM cost, optimizes for fat-loss or Michelin standards, and generates interactive HTML/PDF recipe portals.
displayDescription.zh: 支持全网实时检索菜谱、模糊单位自动清洗为商用精准克重(g/ml)、TDEE碳水循环与BOM成本精算、一键科学减脂降卡改造与米其林工艺升维，覆盖科学减脂餐、八大菜系、正统西餐与16+全国硬核区域邪教美食，直出可打印HTML交互式菜谱手册。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想吃正宗川味水煮牛肉，请帮我实时检索并生成【原教旨刀口辣椒版】与【科学减脂降卡版】双方案（精确到克重、油温与BOM成本）。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to make authentic Sichuan Boiled Beef (Shuizhu Niurou). Please generate both the authentic traditional version and a low-calorie fat-loss version with exact gram measurements, temperatures, and BOM cost.

quickPrompts.zh: 我想吃正宗川味水煮牛肉，请帮我生成【原教旨版】与【科学减脂版】双方案（精确到克重与油温）。
quickPrompts.en: Generate both an authentic and a fat-loss version of Sichuan Boiled Beef with exact gram measurements and temperatures.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我计算TDEE并定制一份28天碳水循环减脂食谱（女，28岁，165cm，62kg，每周运动3次）。
quickPrompts.en: Calculate my TDEE and create a 28-day carb-cycling fat-loss meal plan (Female, 28yo, 165cm, 62kg, moderate exercise).

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我联网拆解『广西横县鱼生』和『黔东南百草牛瘪火锅』的正宗配方，并做食品安全红线审计。
quickPrompts.en: Fetch and assemble the authentic formulas for Hengxian Raw Fish and Guizhou Niubie Hotpot with food safety redline audits.

quickPrompts.zh: 我要摆摊做『潮汕毒药生腌虾蟹』和『柳州螺蛳粉』，请给出50人份商用备料克重表与BOM毛利核算。
quickPrompts.en: Provide a 50-serving commercial batch scaling table and BOM gross margin analysis for Chaoshan Raw Marinated Seafood and Liuzhou Luosifen.
